description: update calver versioned packages managed by custom.regex manager
every update type except major: calver majors must fall through to override-breaking-changes'
feat(<scope>)!: + BREAKING CHANGE treatment and default.json's major defaults (automerge off,
30-day soak). Without this gate these rules sit later in extends and clobber the breaking
prefix/body for calver majors (observed: authentik 2025.12.4->2026.2.1 cut a patch, PR #2818).
Enumerating update types is deliberate here and deliberately absent from disable-updates rules:
a novel update type escaping this rule falls to default.json's defaults and still renders an
in-enum header (benign); one escaping a disable rule would re-enable a disabled package (not benign).
